This file guides Claude Code for an MCP server providing structured Markdown Go updates/best practices. v0.2.0; supports Go 1.13–1.24; clean architecture and Go 1.24 practices.

Commands:
`go build -o recent-go-mcp`
`go test ./...`
`go test -v -run TestMCPServer`
`go mod tidy`
`go fmt ./...`
`go vet ./...`

Examples:
`go test -v -run TestMCPServer`
`echo '{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/list"}' | ./recent-go-mcp`
`echo '{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call", "params": {"name": "go-updates", "arguments": {"version": "1.24"}}}' | ./recent-go-mcp`
`echo '{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call", "params": {"name": "go-updates", "arguments": {"version": "1.22", "package": "slices"}}}' | ./recent-go-mcp`

Architecture: **main.go** (MCP server, `NewMCPServer()`, version, `//go:embed`); **internal/domain/** (models/interfaces/errors); **internal/service/** (context-aware logic); **internal/storage/** (embedded filesystem, slices); **internal/version/** (`go/version`); **data/releases/** (JSON Go 1.13–1.24). Clean architecture, DI, repository pattern, MCP, SOLID, structured logging, error handling, context propagation.

Add releases: create `data/releases/go{version}.json`; embedded repository loads `.json` automatically; no code changes required; follow JSON structure (version, changes, package updates); sorting/comparison automatic.

Tests cover MCP `NewInProcessClient`, unit tests/mocks, semantic comparison, DI/context. Releases sort newest first; changes: "new", "enhancement", "performance", "breaking", "deprecation".

Tool `go-updates`: required version; optional package; structured Markdown, examples, impact indicators, upgrade recommendations, ~70% reduced output. Highlights `slices`, `maps`, `log/slog`, `go/version`. Demonstrates `slices.SortFunc`, `slices.Clone`, `slices.IndexFunc`, `strings.Builder`, `log/slog`, `go/version`.
